description: Boundary data of the densely inhabited districts (DID) of the 2020 Census (Statistics Bureau of Japan, e-Stat). Boundaries, population and area of all 1,463 districts in Japan, one multipolygon row per district.

table:columns.name: admin_code
table:columns.description: Added column (not in the source). Local government code (5-digit string, without the check digit), joining the source KEN (prefecture code) and CITY (municipality code). Codes as of 1 October 2020; designated cities are split into wards.

table:columns.name: pref_code
table:columns.description: Original column: KEN. Prefecture code (2-digit string, 01 Hokkaido to 47 Okinawa).

table:columns.name: municipality_name
table:columns.description: Original column: CITYNAME. Municipality name as of 1 October 2020 (in Japanese). Wards of designated cities include the city name, e.g. "札幌市北区".

table:columns.name: did_number
table:columns.description: Original column: CLASS. Number of the densely inhabited district within the municipality (from 1), in descending order of population; 1 is the largest. admin_code and did_number together identify a row.

table:columns.name: population
table:columns.description: Original column: JINKO. Population of the densely inhabited district (persons, 2020 Census).

table:columns.name: area_km2
table:columns.description: Original column: MENSEKI. Area of the densely inhabited district (km², two decimal places). The source value, not computed from the geometry.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Feature bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). The GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column, used to skip row groups in spatial filters.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Boundary of the densely inhabited district as a multipolygon in EPSG:4326. Invalid shapes (such as self-touching rings) in five source rows were repaired with ST_MakeValid; the areas are unchanged.

title: Densely inhabited districts (2020)
attribution: "2020 Population Census, boundary data of densely inhabited districts" (Statistics Bureau of Japan), modified
